## Summary

Describe the behavior or maintenance change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] I added or updated coverage at the cheapest reliable test layer.
- [ ] I ran the relevant build, lint, and test commands.
- [ ] I did not include secrets, private data, signing files, or unlicensed assets.
- [ ] I documented any external service or privacy impact.
